phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: Evaluate wins
phases.what_happens: Evaluate wins: Cluster areas of 5 symbols or more

phases.what_happens: Winning symbols explode/are removed; remaining symbols fall; new symbols drop in. Continues while new wins appear.

phases.name: End-of-drop features

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.

The game is played in two modes, normal mode and bonus mode with free drops.
The Wild symbols substitute for any paying symbol.
The Wild symbols can have multipliers that multiply its win. Multiple Wild multipliers in a win will be added together.
The multiplying Wild symbol can have a multiplier value of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 10.
Any paying symbol can appear as big symbols in size of 2x2 and 3x3 cells.
